cases.name: Campaign refund window
cases.question: Can I get a refund within 7 days?
cases.ai_answer: can i get a refund within 7 daysについては、Refund requests must be submitted within 7 days of purchase only for campaign tagged products. Standard products are not refundable unless a legal defect review is approved.

cases.name: Free-trial cancellation
cases.question: If I cancel during the free trial will I still be charged?
cases.ai_answer: if i cancel during the free trial will i still be chargedについては、Free trial cancellations must be submitted before the trial ends to prevent paid conversion. Support cannot reverse a paid conversion automatically after it has started.

cases.name: Mid-term annual cancellation
cases.question: If I cancel mid-term can the remaining annual charge be waived?
cases.ai_answer: if i cancel mid-term can the remaining annual charge be waivedについては、Annual plan cancellation stops the next renewal only. Remaining contract charges are not waived unless a manual exception is approved.

cases.name: Chargeback and refund overlap
cases.question: Can I open a chargeback and still expect a normal refund flow?
cases.ai_answer: can i open a chargeback and still expect a normal refund flowについては、support before opening a chargeback. Once a chargeback is opened the refund review is paused and the AI must not promise both paths at the same time.

cases.name: Monthly cancellation timing
cases.question: If I cancel now does billing stop today?
cases.ai_answer: if i cancel now does billing stop todayについては、Cancellation requests may be submitted at any time but billing stops at the next renewal date. Monthly cancellation does not stop billing on the same day.

cases.name: Plan price display
cases.question: Where are current plan prices shown?
cases.ai_answer: where are current plan prices shownについては、Plan prices are shown on the pricing page and the current billing currency is displayed there.

cases.name: Annual discount disclosure
cases.question: Is the annual plan discount a standard promise?
cases.ai_answer: is the annual plan discount a standard promiseについては、Annual discounts must follow the published annual plan page and support must not promise a discount that is not part of the current offer.

cases.name: Auto-renewal notice
cases.question: When is the renewal notice sent?
cases.ai_answer: when is the renewal notice sentについては、Auto-renewal notices are sent at least 30 days before renewal for active contracts.

cases.name: Contract amendment timing
cases.question: Can a contract amendment be applied mid-term?
cases.ai_answer: can a contract amendment be applied mid-termについては、Contract amendment requests may be processed mid-term only after support review and written confirmation.
